correctness.rationale: The grounded follower Laplacian on K_{p,q}, with a leaders in its p-vertex part, reduces to scalar orthogonal modes q and p and a 2×2 constant-vector block. Thus for u=p-a,v=q-3+a its inverse trace is J_a=(u-1)/q+(v-1)/p+(p+q)/(pq-uv), with direct diagonal interpretation if u or v=0. I verified the three key rational-difference identities algebraically and independently checked 3240 exact rational finite phase cases (p=2..28 and q up to 134) against the complete five-boundary table. The signs of J1−J2 and J0−J3 and the factored J3−J2, together with the transformed numerator (6-p)k²+(-2p²+7p-6)k−4p² for p>=6, prove all infinite integer cases without relying on finite tests. The p=2 cases have a separate exact difference J0−J1=(q−6)(q−1)/(6q).
residual_risks: Source finite verification is supportive, not an exhaustive infinity proof; no claims for weighted graphs, other leader budgets, noisy leaders, or eigenvalue maximization.
